findings.F1: The result is on the side the idea predicts but too varied for 750 cases to show it: the 7-day unusual move is +0.73 % (t 1.27; size +0.88 %, strength 0.062, total move 9.9 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade), while by year it ranges from −4.96 % in 2018 (t −2.55, 65 cases), −4.74 % in 2019 and −4.11 % in 2022, to +2.11 % in 2020, +3.06 % in 2021 (t 2.04) and +0.82 % to +1.41 % in 2024 and 2025.
findings.F2: The grading is clear and monotonic, so the weak mean comes from the weakest cases diluting the strong ones: by quarter of the forecast the 7-day unusual move is −1.79 % (t −1.82, forecast near 2.8), +0.29 %, +1.86 % (t 1.85) and +2.58 % (t 1.81, forecast near 19.5); the upper half beats the lower by +2.97 %.
findings.F3: The effect splits by coin: positive on BTC (+0.94 %, t 1.24), ETH (+1.06 %), XRP (+1.65 %) and ZEC (+2.68 %), negative on LTC (−0.84 %) and XMR (−0.59 %), each over only 99 to 163 cases.
findings.F4: The plan's 7-day horizon sits where the effect is already fading. Over 1 day its strength is 0.026 (t 1.72, 5,343 cases), over 3 days 0.054 (t 1.95, 1,770), over 7 days 0.050 (t 1.27). Over 14 days it falls to 0.016 (t 0.55), and over 30 days it is −0.038.
findings.F5: The month's sign does carry information inside up years: on bars with a positive 1-year return but no positive 30-day rise, the move is negative at every horizon (−0.78 % over 7 days, t −1.57; −0.43 % over 3 days, t −1.97). Outside up years it is about zero (−0.08 % over 7 days, t −0.21).

ideas.name: monthly continuation, more coins
ideas.idea: In a year when a coin's own 1-year return is positive, a coin whose 30-day return is positive rises over the next 7 days by more than its usual 7-day drift, more as its 30-day return is larger.
ideas.consequence: A month-long rise is a reason to go long for a week mainly while the coin's year is rising, and a reason to refuse that trade while its year is falling.

ideas.idea: In a year when a coin's own 1-year return is positive, a coin whose 30-day return is positive rises over the next 3 days by more than its usual 3-day drift, more as its 30-day return is larger.
ideas.consequence: A month-long rise in an up year is a reason to go long for a few days rather than a week, and a reason to refuse that trade while the coin's year is falling.
